evals.name: case-1-labels
evals.description: New server module (routes → service → repository) with an infrastructure-in-routes violation, a concrete-adapter-construction violation, and a Zod-contract fork.
evals.prompt: Review this fixture (a small standalone backend module styled after server/src/modules/<name>/) against the onion-architecture skill's rules, exactly as you would review a real PR touching server/src/modules/**. Treat db.ts/adapters.ts/container.ts/shared.ts as local stand-ins for the real server/src/db, server/src/adapters, server/src/platform/container.ts, and @devdigest/shared. Report every onion-architecture violation you find: file, function/section, which rule/anti-pattern it violates, and why.

evals.name: case-2-comments-scoring
evals.description: A reviewer-core 'pure' domain file that reaches for a concrete LLM adapter, plus a server module with a re-declaring repository facade and a cross-module repository import.
evals.prompt: Review this fixture (standalone, but styled after reviewer-core/src/** and server/src/modules/**) against the onion-architecture skill's rules. Map reviewer-core/ to the real reviewer-core/src/** (pure domain core with an injected LLMProvider port). Map server/comments/ and server/agents/ to real server/src/modules/<name>/ feature modules, and server/container.ts/server/db.ts to server/src/platform/container.ts/server/src/db/**. Report every onion-architecture violation you find: file, function/section, which rule/anti-pattern it violates, and why.

evals.name: case-3-annotations
evals.description: New server module with business logic + raw Drizzle in routes.ts, a concrete LLM-adapter construction in service.ts, and a Zod-contract fork.
evals.prompt: Review this fixture (standalone, but styled after server/src/modules/<name>/) against the onion-architecture skill's rules. Treat container.ts/db.ts/shared.ts as local stand-ins for server/src/platform/container.ts/server/src/db/**/@devdigest/shared. Treat llm/llm-provider.ts and llm/openrouter.ts as stand-ins for the real LLMProvider port and its concrete adapter. Report every onion-architecture violation you find: file, function/section, which rule/anti-pattern it violates, and why.
